card.text: Explore IAU in 3D with its published shape model and documented physical size scale.

introduction.text: Coarse lightcurve reconstruction, with an approximate size from infrared observations. The grid marks unavailable surface imagery.

shape.title: Light-curve shape model
shape.detail: Published shape · grid marks missing imagery
shape.summary: Thermal diameter 4.242 ± 0.917 km; quoted fit error excludes about 10% systematic uncertainty and shape/aspect effects. Its single thermal band requires an assumed beaming parameter; shape is coarse and rotational phase illustrative.

elevation.title: Shape-derived elevations
elevation.summary: Radius on the shape model minus a 2.121 km reference sphere, in false color. Heights inherit the size uncertainty; this is not independent topography or gravitational height.
